batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c GJ Bailey b L Balaji

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c GJ Maxwell b AR Patel

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b P Awana

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c R Dhawan b L Balaji

balls.text: holes out at long-off and Chennai finish at 205. Another full toss outside off but Dhoni can't get the meaty part of the bat on this. Lofts it down the throat of Rishi Dhawan
races down the track and though the bowler went short and tried to put it past the reach of Dhoni's lashing blade, the captain connects and powerfully enough to beat the fielder at deep midwicket
another full toss on middle and leg, Bravo flicks wide of long-on
full tos outside off and Bravo has crashed it over the man at deep cover. Punjab, as they have been doing all innings, are missing their lengths
full and wide outside off, Dhoni has one foot off the ground and laces it to deep point
and offers up a length ball with enough room for Dhoni to crunch it over long-on. Massive six
slower ball outside off, Dhoni eases it through point with an open face
shortish and ducking back in at him, Bravo rides it down to deep third man

scooped it straight into the hands of Sehwag at short fine leg. It was the offcutter which did not allow Raina the pace he wanted. Walked right across his stumps to manufacture a big shot and perishes
shortish and on the stumps, Raina was cramped while he was trying to pull that away. Gets it off the higher part of the bat to long-on
again ample opportunity to swing those shoulders and Dhoni lashes to the sweeper again
length ball with loads of room and Dhoni belts it to the man at deep cover
fullish on off stump, hacked down to long-on
fullish and outside off, Dhoni drags it out to midwicket
thumped down the ground but long-off is on hand to keep it to a single. Doesn't get the yorker right
slower ball outside off, Raina was backing away towards the leg side though and had reach out for it. Finds point
length ball on off stump, Raina swings it down to deep square leg. Hadn't middled it properly
full on off stump, carted down the ground to long-on
gets another fortuitous edge to the third man boundary. This is what happens when you can't execute that wide yorker, too much room on offer and an open blade is enough to take advantage
good length ball, possibly a bit slower outside off. Dhoni was down the track and guides it to short third man. An overthrow allows for a second
low full toss wide of off stump and Dhoni squeezes it away to the third man boundary
backs away and slashes a length ball behind point to bring MS Dhoni the new batsman on strike

one slog too many for Smith and he has to walk back dismissed off a full toss. Sought the wide yorker again but it ends up a lovely delivery to be smacked over the covers but Smith swing across the line and got a leading edge which is taken by Bailey in the covers
Pitches the wide Yorker right this time and though Smith shuffles across and looks to steer it to third man, he can't connect
Slower full toss and he directs it a little too far outside off
low full toss on off stump, Raina opts for a nudge to the free-hit delivery and can't even beat the bowler
he's overstepped. What is happening with Mitchell Johnson?! He got the length right though, fullish delivery pushed down to mid-off
fired in full and outside off, Raina steers it through point with an open face
length ball on off stump, Raina swings madly and gets it more off a thickish inside edge than anything. But it's got enough wood on it to find the boundary at deep midwicket
141kph, nice and full outside off as he drags it away wide of long-on
doesn't find the block hole this time and Smith sees it in the slot and pummels it to the long-on boundary
goes for the yorker on off stump, Raina is good enough to dig it out past the bowler's extended left hand
tossed up on off stump, Smith gets onto the front foot and slams it down the ground. Soaring six over long-on
flighted outside off, Smith gets down on one-knee and reverses sweeps it to the third man boundary
skips down the track and looks to beat short cover but has to settle for the single when Bailey misfields
tossed up on middle, Raina looks to drive through extra and gets an inside edge onto pad
full on middle, clipped away to deep midwicket
stays put to loft the overpitched delivery to long-off. Hit in the air bit falls short of the man rushing in
shortish and on middle, pulled to deep midwicket
dropped by the keeper. Slower ball off the back of the hand, Raina made some room to drive through the off side and gets a thick edge which the Saha can't rein in
fires it in on middle and leg and it's punched down to long-on. Nicely bowled
full and on off stump, Smith pushes back to the bowler
dabs it nice and fine and gets off the mark with a boundary. Hint of room outside off and Raina goes back and opens the face to beat short third man
full toss outside off, pushed down the ground to long-off

pushed through on middle and leg as he rocks back and goes for an almighty pull. Hasn't connected it properly and Maxi at deep midwicket takes a tumbling catch to break Chennai's seventh century opening partnership
stays beside the ball which is fired in outside off, steered to point
races down the track as he makes some room and launches this over the man at long-off
flighted on middle and off, he goes for a sweep but manages an inside edge which must have saved him
good length ball outside off, it was a little slower too and he taps it down to the man at deep cover
drags it from well outside off and pulls down to long-on. Short of a good length again
back of a length and it gets a little extra from the pitch as McCullum's slash comes out second best
good length ball on and around off stump, Smith punches it down to long-off
length ball outside off, McCullum is balanced at the crease and pulls it to deep midwicket
he waited on it but the cut shot still finds point, that first ball six has made him fire the rest in
short again, McCullum rocks back and cuts to the sweeper
flat-batted down the ground as this is shortish and outside off
pulls the pace off it and this turns away from the bat, it was the legspinner from Maxi and Smith was well beaten
fired in outside off, driven down the ground for a couple. Good running
again offers him room and the length to get under and Smith has carted it over long-on
fullish and outside off, he goes for a hack to midwicket and gets an inside edge
keeps him quiet with a very full delivery just outside off
dances down the track while making room for himself and laces a drive to long-off
pulls all the pace off this ball as he targets the wide line. He reaches out and slashes it over the infield for the fastest hundred of the tournament so far
width outside off and Smith comes forward and powers it to the left of mid-off
full and just outside off, he drives all along the ground to deep cover
fired in on middle and leg, Baz shuffles across and clips it behind square leg
shortish and angled into him, Baz pushes down the ground
goes shorter and quicker, Smith works it for a single to midwicket
that's a bazooka down the ground! Loved the flight on this and just bludgeoned it off the front foot
pulls the flight back a bit which allows Baz to go back and nudge it around the corner
nice bowling that, tossed up on middle and keeps McCullum to a defensive push

little too ambitions from Smith. It was back of a length and the width lured him into chasing it. But he was on the front foot, which foiled his chances of connecting. And Punjab breathe a sigh of relief as the strategic time out is called
slower ball angled into him, worked away into the midwicket region
slashed behind point and this time Johnson isn't quick enough to cut it off. That's fifty for McCullum on Chennai debut and on the seventh-year anniversary of his 158
that's better. Tighter line on off stump and a fuller length. Pushed to long-on
this time on the diametrically opposite side of the field. Punjab are spraying it around here. Short ball outside off slapped to the sweeper
oh dear, he can't bowl short at his pace. Baz saw it early and hammers it over the square leg boundary.
good length ball cut off the stumps for a single through the covers
goes for the sweep this time as he sees a bit more flight on it, struck on the front pad but it might have been sliding down leg
fires it down the leg side again, that's the second one off target
stays back and tucks the short of a length ball away into the square leg region
a lot quicker this time and it goes on with the arm, defended
shuffles across a bit and turns the tossed up ball off his pads for a single in front of square leg
flatter delivery on the stumps, picked away through midwicket
slides a length ball down the leg side
fires it in on off stump, McCullum drills it back down the ground and it's so straight it hits the timber at the bowler's end
pummeled into the grass banks! It's short, it's on the leg stump and it's been pulled with the utmost authority. No point keeping it down when you can hit it that far
skips down the track and looks to smash it down the ground, but swings down the wrong line. Well beaten
offers up another overpitched delivery outside off, Baz says thank you very much and lofts it over extra cover
a little slower on off stump, Smith is wise to it and guides it off the back foot to third man
fullish on middle and leg, nudged to short midwicket
into orbit! Races down the track to pick it up off a length and deposit well into the crowd behind long-on. McCullum's done away with defensive strokes

dropped, it's the captain himself at mid-on who spills it. It was a length ball on off stump, Baz plants his front leg down and slaps it down the ground. Doesn't time it at all and the fielder had to go to his left a bit. Dives at the last minute but the ball bursts through. That's 5000 T20 runs for McCullum
he tried his hardest to reach the short ball outside off but it was just too far away.
shortish delivery, pulled to square leg. Didn't get the middle
continues back of a length but this is the slower one, Smith works it into the leg side to bring up the Chennai fifty
bit of extra bounce outside off the off and Smith rides it well enough with a cut that sails well over the infield. Couple of bounces and into the hoardings
digs it into the middle of the deck again and Smith is comfortably pulling them from the crease to the square leg boundary
full and angled into the pads, Smith isn't able to whip it away and has to settle for a single
waits on this nicely, stays beside the shortish ball and taps to deep cover
charges down the track and the change of pace deceives Baz. Looks to lash through the off side but gets a bottom edge to mid-on
pushes this on the pads and Smith tries to work it into the midwicket, doesn't get bat to it though
shortish and outside off, Smith doesn't bother with the feet again as he flashes outside off. Ump says he's toed the wrong side of the line
shifted his weight onto the back foot and he's just picked up this short ball from outside off and carted it to the square leg boundary. Whistled away to the boundary
back of a length on off stump, Smith punches down to mid-on
phew, what a strike! It was short and afforded him enough room to upper cut it and he's put enough muscle into it to clear the ropes
fires it in full and outside off, Baz was rooted to the crease and goes for an expansive cover drive but only manages an inside edges it
dug in short and Baz was cramped for room, looks to pull it down to long leg but he wasn't in control of that
back of a length on middle and leg, he goes back and blocks and manages an inside edge that squirts out into the on side
smashed! Overpitched from Johnson and he eases onto his front foot and drills it through extra cover
138 kph, the lack of pace surprised Baz. Think this held in the pitch a little more Baz who was looking to drive on the up had to check his shot. Went uppishly but it evaded the cover field
fullish and on the stumps, he pushes it down to mid-on
shortish and just enough room for Baz to tap it into the covers where Rishi Dhawan sprawls to left to save a boundary
Punjab need to get their lines right, that's their second spill down the leg side
charges him and looks to smash the length ball into the leg side. Inside edges it to short fine. Played way too early
got a lot closer to off stump with the back of a length delivery, McCullum goes for the pull and gets a top edge that sails over the keeper's desperate leap
he tried to outsmart him by bowling short but McCullum's so good square of the wicket. Raced down the track and though it was dug in short he lashed it over the infield to the point boundary
cracked off the back foot as he starts off with a shortish delivery with a bit of room. Baz's flaying blade finds cover
hustles for a quick single and had the bowler's throw broken the stumps things might have been interesting. Baz nudged to the right of the bowler and took off just that smallest bit late
flighted on middle and off, he comes forward to block
goes on with the arm and Baz takes it off middle stump and chops to backward point
tossed up outside off, driven into the covers
fires a flatter one down the leg side, Baz goes for a pull but it is too far for him to reach and the ball skims off the turf
shortish and cut behind square. Sloppy work from short third man. Seemed to have had it covered but then he mistimed the dive and gifts a single. Not the best start to the match for Sehwag
drifting on the pads and Smith eases it to deep midwicket
that's emphatic! Short ball pulled powerfully to the deep midwicket boundary and the two Punjab batsman exchange big smiles and a hug as well
in the slot and Bailey has hoicked it over the long-on boundary. Cleared his front leg and let the hands go
good length ball which grips the pitch and darts outside off, Bailey muscles a mistimed pull through midwicket
full toss outside off, Miller flashes and gets a thick outside edge to third man
shortish and outside off, cut away strongly to deep extra cover
walked at the bowler who fired in a leg stump yorker, misses the flick and the stumps en route to the keeper
finds the yorker outside off and Bailey pushes it down to long-on
full and speared in on the pads, Bailey looks to swipe it away but gets struck on the pads. No appeal, would have gone well down leg
low full toss outside off, Miller opens the face and slices it to deep point
slower ball on off stump, Bailey isn't fooled as he dabs into the covers and rotates the strike. That's all that's needed with an equation reading 14 off 16
full toss on leg stump, picked away to deep midwicket
good length ball on middle and off, he strides forward to push it down the ground to long-on
good length ball on middle and leg, turned away to deep square leg for a couple that brings Miller his fifty
over long-off this time. Punjab are in a hurry to finish this off. Another little trip down the track and though it hit the bottom of the bat, it had enough to clear the fielder in the deep
offers length and Miller has pounced. He was down the track and belts it way into the crowd behind long-on
a little more flight but he's pushing towards leg stump. Bailey works it away behind square leg
darted in on leg stump, Bailey swivels on the back foot and sweeps it down to long leg
that was clever. Waited on this shortish ball with just a little room and he dabbed it fine of short third man and it just skimmed away
fullish on off stump, eased through point to get off the mark

what a yorker! Leg stump has been uprooted. There was no room to manoevre it, which was what Maxi was trying to do with a bit of an open face but the ball just kept coming in at him and cramping him up. He also seemed a little surprised by the extra pace on that and walks off the field with his bat raised. He's missed a personal landmark, but has placed his team in a very good position
sliding down the pads and he's whipped it away to the long leg boundary. He's stormed into the mid-nineties now
length ball on off stump, Maxwell's hammered it down the ground. Just throw the ball back from beyond the boundary
fired in full on leg stump to cramp him for room, Miller clips to deep square leg
flighted on the pads, nudged into midwicket
was that another switch hit? He changed his stance but not the grip on his bat as he reverse swept to third man
skips down the track but has to settle for an inside edge that squirts off to deep square leg. He's been off colour all through but Punjab are still in the driver's seat
short and on the pads again, Maxi pulls to deep square leg
it's the carrom ball this time and he's pitched it rather wide outside leg. Maxi goes for a swat seeking the long leg boundary, but misses
clipped away neatly off his legs as Ashwin fears to toss the ball up. That's the 100 partnership. Maxi's got 67 of them
starts off with a legspinner which Maxi picks as he charges down the track and slams it to the long-off boundary
shortish and outside off, Miller cracks it to point
fullish and outside off, he pushes it down to long-on
another drop, by Badree the substitute fielder. It was short and outside off. Maxi pulls it to deep square leg who had to come forward as the ball was dipping.
big full toss outside of and Maxi's reverse pulled it over the head of short third man
nearly a yorker on middle and leg, dug out to long-on
fullish and outside off, pushed down the ground
backs away and drives past the man at extra cover
fired in on middle and off, Maxi closed the face too early and gets a leading edge to long-off
flighted outside off and he essays a lovely, orthodox cover drive. All along the ground and stamped with his considerable power. There is no stopping him today
backs away and fools the bowler to bowling a wide down the off side
there wasn't much room to get under this but somehow he does and the sweep skims hard and flat to the deep midwicket boundary
short ball on off stump, Maxi rocks back and smashes it way into the grass banks at cow corner

tossed up on off stump, Maxi plants his front leg down the pitch and slogged it away to the deep midwicket boundary. The fielder tried to flick it back into the field of play, but he was stamping on the boundary ropes while doing so

big appeal from the bowler, who trips over his feet and falls flat on his back. Maxi went down for the sweep again only this skidded on and strikes him on the back pad. No bat involved. This was plumb, but the umpire hasn't spotted it
pulled wide of long-on as this was fired in short on middle
drifting down on the pads and he sweeps him one-bounce to the long leg boundary to raise his fifty
comes down the track to work it into the leg side and gets an inside edge onto pad. Jaddu appeals but is turned down
he's switch hit to the point boundary! Changed his stance and then the grip on his bat and blasted it away to Bravo who was down there. Pulled out a diving effort but couldn't pull it back
carted away to deep midwicket. Charged at the carrom ball and slogged it away
fired in on leg stump, Miller's inside edge allows him a single through square leg
full toss on leg stump, swept away to deep square leg
carrom ball pitching outside leg, Maxi was setting up to launch it over cow corner but the length was too full. Squirts it away to deep square leg
rushes down the track and swings off his feet, only manages an inside edge behind square leg
rocks back and cuts the shortish ball outside off to the sweeper
Miller gets a life now. It was flighted outside off and he thumps it into the covers. Faf dives full length to his right and almost hand it but it popped out

dropped and it is the most comical of the lot. Maxi goes for the reverse sweep but this time he gets it off the shoulder of the bat and it goes straight up. Nehra is at short third man and he lunges at the ball with both hands outstretched. Only kisses the fingers. VIntage Nehra
turned away with the turn through square leg again
charges at him but as he finds the length is a little shorter he settles for a nudge through square leg
punched down the ground to long-off and that will be a strategic time out
has trouble beating that man at midwicket as Negi continues darting in length balls on the stumps
pushed down the ground as he pushes it through on off stump
fires it in on middle and off, which is whipped into leg side
shortish delivery on leg stump, worked to midwikcet
lovely footwork as he leaves the crease to reach the pitch and a full swing of the arms brings up another straight six
laps it over the keeper for a neat little boundary. Long leg was too square and can only collect the ball after it crossed the boundary
fired in on the pads, Maxi can't put it away with the flick. Shakes his head
tossed up on off stump, Miller is forward and drives it past a diving Jadeja to long-on
short and wide again, Miller slaps it through the covers this time and the man out in the deep cannot pull it back. Excellent placement
comes forward and pushes at the length ball on off stump. Gets an inside edge to mid-on
starts off with a short one which Miller has no problem cutting behind square
stays in his crease this time and clips the length ball to deep square leg
defeats the left-hander in flight this time. He was coming down the track but the ball dips before he could reach the pitch of it. Leading edge into the covers while he was trying to flick it
shortish on off stump, Miller punches it back to the bowler

beaten by flight but the leading edge face safely. This gripped into the pitch and turned away and with Maxwell going across the line with a flick, the ball loops straight into the air but clears cover and mid-off
short and pushed through on off stump, Maxi is on the back foot and pulls wide of long-on
flighted on the pads, worked away to deep midwicket
tossed up on off stump, defended with soft hands into the covers
pushed through quicker on off stump, he goes for the sweep but gets an inside edge
flighted down the leg side and though Maxi was looking for the sweep, he holds his pose and collects the extra
carrom ball goes awry and Dhoni does well to collect it way down the leg side
makes room outside leg and lofts this over the covers. Opens the face of the bat to hoist it over mid-off and extra cover. Neat placement
the amount of power he can get into that stroke is unbelievable. Tossed up outside leg and the bat speed while he reverse sweeps that gives it all the legs it needs to reach the point boundary
flighted on middle and leg, clipped to long-on

trapped in the crease and Akshar has to trudge back. No doubt about this one. This came on with the arm and struck him on the back pad as he was looking to clip to midwicket. The ball skids on and he's a goner
strays in line in addition to length this time as he bowls on the pads, Maxi whips it away to the square leg boundary with ease
down the ground and picks this up off a length and thumps it to the long-off boundary. Didn't get it off the meat but with his power you don't really need to
slower ball accompanied by a big grunt. Maxi was on the front foot and goes for that pull again, but the ball just scuttles underneath his bat
charges down the track and the room he's made for himself allows the carve into the covers but McCullum dives to his right and keeps it to none
back of a length and he was setting up for the front foot pull, doesn't succeed
magnificent! Just a little overpitched and he leans into the most correct off drive. Effortlessly punched away and Bravo's dive is not enough to stop it
whipped away as he meets the ball in front of his pad and picks up a couple to deep square leg
tossed up on middle and leg, Akshar plays across the line and is struck on the knee-roll. Big shout from the bowler again but this time the ump doesn't agree. It was tighter than the Pujara one...

it's given! That's a pretty tight call from the ump and Pujara walks back looking a little bemused. It pitched in line and went on with the arm as he went for a sweep. Struck low on the front pad and it might just have grazed off stump.
clears his front leg and drives down to long-off. Tossed up offspinner that time
doesn't bother with this length ball down the leg side. Think it was the carrom again
no need to get your eye in, just pull out that reverse sweep and drag the carrom ball from way outside leg stump to the point boundary. That is just a top shot
flighted on leg stump as Pujara comes down the track and pushes down to long-on

leg stump cartwheels! It was length and he was looking to slog it across the line seeking the stands at midwicket. Missed it by several inches as the ball sneaks between the bat and pad. Nehra exults!
lifted over the covers. Just clean hand-eye coordination and the fuller delivery on off stump is hoisted away. Opened the face on impact to place it in the gap
backs away and mauls this over point. Short and wide and that was just begging to be hit. Viru, of course, is not known for holding back
fullish and outside off, driven to mid-off

picked up off his hips and dropped into the square leg boundary. Nehra, as a few of our readers suspected, has begun to leak runs. Short in length and on leg stump. Looks like he hasn't learned from Punjab's bowling display earlier
fullish and on the pads, Pujara whips it through midwicket. What lovely wristwork!

Jadeja races back, keeping his eyes on the ball over his shoulder and flings both hands out in front of him but the ball doesn't stay inside. How costly will that drop be? It was full and Sehwag shoveled it straight over the top with very little timing.
back of a good length and outside off, Viru slashes and misses. A sight as common as those booming boundaries
on the pads and he flicks it smartly behind square. Bad line with the fine leg inside the circle and all Viru had to do was give it direction
a little more effort behind this delivery and the bounce beats Sehwag's cut
crisp! It was length with just the smallest bit of room but Viru was onto it in a flash. A little shuffle back and he punches it through point and watched the ball whistle away .
good length ball outside off, Pujara slashes with an open face and finds deep third man
short but not quite wide enough, Viru flat bats it down to mid-off.
back of a length on off stump, Pujara waits on the back foot and tucks it into the midwicket region
full and outside off, Pujara looks to blast it through the covers but mistimes it. Baz cuts the angle and dives to his right to keep it to none
as ever minimum footwork but those hands are good enough to cut the shortish delivery down to deep third man
good length ball just outside off, Pujara guides it to deep third man
hint of inward dip to start off, Pujara negotiates it well by coming forward and presenting a straight bat
